# cardinalR

[![CRAN_Status_Badge](http://www.r-pkg.org/badges/version/cardinalR)](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=cardinalR)
[![Downloads](http://cranlogs.r-pkg.org/badges/cardinalR)](https://cran.r-project.org/package=cardinalR)

The `cardinalR` package provides a collection of functions to generate a
large variety of structures in high dimensions.

## Installation

You can install the released version of `cardinalR` from
[CRAN](https://CRAN.R-project.org) with:

``` r
install.packages("cardinalR") 
```

The development version from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("JayaniLakshika/cardinalR")
```

## Example

``` r
library(cardinalR)
```

``` r
head(mobiusgau, 5)
#> # A tibble: 5 × 4
#>        x1       x2       x3      x4
#>     <dbl>    <dbl>    <dbl>   <dbl>
#> 1  0.517  -0.579   -0.00951 -0.0401
#> 2  0.0142 -0.00841  0.0147   0.0579
#> 3 -0.402   0.506   -0.196   -0.0325
#> 4 -0.218  -0.684    0.0347   0.0497
#> 5  0.225   0.699    0.00575  0.0251
```

To view the data in high-dimensional space

``` r
langevitour(mobiusgau)
```

Following shows three 2-D projections from the 4-D `mobiusgau` data.

|                                                                      |                                                                      |                                                                      |
|:--------------------------------------------------------------------:|:--------------------------------------------------------------------:|:--------------------------------------------------------------------:|
| ![Mobius Gaussian data projection 1](reference/figures/mobius_1.png) | ![Mobius Gaussian data projection 2](reference/figures/mobius_2.png) | ![Mobius Gaussian data projection 3](reference/figures/mobius_3.png) |

You can find the high-dimensional view in
[here](https://youtu.be/D2drIAnz4pM).

tSNE (t-distributed Stochastic Neighbor Embedding) and UMAP (Uniform
Manifold Approximation and Projection) representations of `mobiusgau`
are shown below. Figures a–c illustrate the t-SNE projections and
figures d–f present the corresponding UMAP projections.

![tSNE and UMAP layouts with different hyperparameter
choices.](reference/figures/README-unnamed-chunk-6-1.png)

## About the name

**c**ollection of v**ar**ious high-**d**imens**i**o**nal** data
structures in **R**

# Package index

## Data

The example data sets.

- [`mobiusgau`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/mobiusgau.md)
  : Mobius clust dataset with a noise dimension
- [`mobiusgau_tsne1`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/mobiusgau_tsne1.md)
  : tSNE embedding for mobiusgau dataset which with noise dimensions
  tSNE parameters set to perplexity: 15.
- [`mobiusgau_tsne2`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/mobiusgau_tsne2.md)
  : tSNE embedding for mobiusgau dataset which with noise dimensions
  tSNE parameters set to perplexity: 30.
- [`mobiusgau_tsne3`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/mobiusgau_tsne3.md)
  : tSNE embedding for mobiusgau dataset which with noise dimensions
  tSNE parameters set to perplexity: 5.
- [`mobiusgau_umap1`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/mobiusgau_umap1.md)
  : UMAP embedding for mobiusgau dataset which with noise dimensions
  UMAP parameters set to n-neigbors: 15 and min-dist: 0.1.
- [`mobiusgau_umap2`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/mobiusgau_umap2.md)
  : UMAP embedding for mobiusgau dataset which with noise dimensions
  UMAP parameters set to n-neigbors: 30 and min-dist: 0.08.
- [`mobiusgau_umap3`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/mobiusgau_umap3.md)
  : UMAP embedding for mobiusgau dataset which with noise dimensions
  UMAP parameters set to n-neigbors: 5 and min-dist: 0.9.
- [`three_clust_01`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/three_clust_01.md)
  : Three-Cluster Dataset in 4-D
- [`three_clust_02`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/three_clust_02.md)
  : Three-Cluster Dataset in 4-D
- [`three_clust_03`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/three_clust_03.md)
  : Three-Cluster Dataset in 4-D
- [`three_clust_04`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/three_clust_04.md)
  : Three-Cluster Dataset in 4-D
- [`three_clust_05`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/three_clust_05.md)
  : Three-Cluster Dataset in 4-D

## Branching

Branching data structure.

- [`gen_expbranches()`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/gen_expbranches.md)
  : Generate data with exponential shaped branches
- [`gen_orglinearbranches()`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/gen_orglinearbranches.md)
  : Generate data with linear shaped branches in a initial point
- [`gen_orgcurvybranches()`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/gen_orgcurvybranches.md)
  : Generate data with curvy shaped branches in a initial point
- [`gen_linearbranches()`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/gen_linearbranches.md)
  : Generate data with linear shaped branches
- [`gen_curvybranches()`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/gen_curvybranches.md)
  : Generate data with curvy shaped branches

## Cone

Cone data structure.

- [`gen_cone()`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/gen_cone.md)
  : Generate Blunted Cone

## Cube

Cube data structure.

- [`gen_gridcube()`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/gen_gridcube.md)
  : Generate Cube with grid points
- [`gen_unifcube()`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/gen_unifcube.md)
  : Generate Cube with uniform points
- [`gen_unifcubehole()`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/gen_unifcubehole.md)
  : Generate Cube with Hole

## Gaussian

Gaussian data structure.

- [`gen_gaussian()`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/gen_gaussian.md)
  : Generate Gaussian

## Linear

Linear data structure.

- [`gen_longlinear()`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/gen_longLinear.md)
  : Generate Long Linear Data

## Mobius

Mobius data structure.

- [`gen_mobius()`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/gen_mobius.md)
  : Generate a 3-D Mobius

## Multiple clusters

Main function.

- [`gen_multicluster()`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/gen_multicluster.md)
  : Generate Multiple Clusters

## Odd shapes

Odd shaped clusters.

- [`make_mobiusgau()`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/make_mobiusgau.md)
  : Generate Gaussian cluster with the Mobius Cluster
- [`make_multigau()`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/make_multigau.md)
  : Generate Multiple Gaussian Clusters
- [`make_curvygau()`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/make_curvygau.md)
  : Generate Curvy Quadratic and Gaussian Clusters
- [`make_klink_circles()`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/make_klink_circles.md)
  : Generate Multiple Interlocked Circles in High-Dimensional Space
- [`make_chain_circles()`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/make_chain_circles.md)
  : Generate a Chain of Interlocked Circles in High-Dimensional Space
- [`make_klink_curvycycle()`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/make_klink_curvycycle.md)
  : Generate Multiple Interlocked curvycycle in High-Dimensional Space
- [`make_chain_curvycycle()`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/make_chain_curvycycle.md)
  : Generate a Chain of Interlocked curvycycle in High-Dimensional Space
- [`make_gaucircles()`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/make_gaucircles.md)
  : Generate Concentric Circles with a Gaussian Cluster in High
  Dimensions
- [`make_gaucurvycycle()`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/make_gaucurvycycle.md)
  : Generate Concentric Curvycycles with a Gaussian Cluster in High
  Dimensions
- [`make_onegrid()`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/make_onegrid.md)
  : Generate a Single Grid Cluster in High Dimensions
- [`make_twogrid_overlap()`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/make_twogrid_overlap.md)
  : Generate Two Overlapping Grid Clusters in High Dimensions
- [`make_twogrid_shift()`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/make_twogrid_shift.md)
  : Generate Two Shifted Grid Clusters in High Dimensions
- [`make_shape_para()`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/make_shape_para.md)
  : Generate Parallel Multi-Shape Clusters

## Polynomial

Polynomial data structures.

- [`gen_quadratic()`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/gen_quadratic.md)
  : Generate Quadratic
- [`gen_cubic()`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/gen_cubic.md)
  : Generate Cubic

## Pyramid

Pyramid data structures.

- [`gen_pyrrect()`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/gen_pyrrect.md)
  : Generate Rectangular Based Pyramid
- [`gen_pyrtri()`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/gen_pyrtri.md)
  : Generate Triangular Based Pyramid
- [`gen_pyrstar()`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/gen_pyrstar.md)
  : Generate Star Based Pyramid
- [`gen_pyrfrac()`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/gen_pyrfrac.md)
  : Generate p-D Triangular Pyramid With Triangular Pyramid shaped holes

S-curve data structures.

- [`gen_scurvehole()`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/gen_scurvehole.md)

Sphere data structures.

- [`gen_circle()`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/gen_circle.md)
  : Generate Circle in p-d
- [`gen_curvycycle()`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/gen_curvycycle.md)

  : Generate Small Spheres Within a Big Sphere
- [`gen_hemisphere()`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/gen_hemisphere.md)
  : Generate Hemisphere
- [`gen_hollowsphere()`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/gen_hollowsphere.md)
  : Generate Hollow Sphere

  : Generate Conical Spiral

  : Generate Nonlinear Hyperbola

## trefoil

trefoil data structures.

- [`gen_trefoil3d()`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/gen_trefoil3d.md)
  : Generate 3-D Trefoil Knot Coordinates (Stereographic Projection)
- [`gen_trefoil4d()`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/gen_trefoil4d.md)
  : Generate 4-D Trefoil Knot Coordinates

## Additional functions

These are additional functionalities.

- [`gen_noisedims()`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/gen_noisedims.md)
  : Generate Random Noise Dimensions
- [`gen_bkgnoise()`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/gen_bkgnoise.md)
  : Generate Background Noise Data
- [`randomize_rows()`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/randomize_rows.md)
  : Randomize Rows of a Data Frame
- [`relocate_clusters()`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/relocate_clusters.md)
  : Relocate Clusters in High-Dimensional Space
- [`gen_nproduct()`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/gen_nproduct.md)
  : Generates a vector of positive integers whose product is
  approximately equal to a target value.
- [`gen_nsum()`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/gen_nsum.md)
  : Generates a vector of positive integers whose summation is
  approximately equal to a target value.
- [`gen_wavydims1()`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/gen_wavydims1.md)
  : Generate Random Noise Dimensions With Wavy Pattern
- [`gen_wavydims2()`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/gen_wavydims2.md)
  : Generate Random Noise Dimensions With Wavy Pattern
- [`gen_wavydims3()`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/gen_wavydims3.md)
  : Generate Random Noise Dimensions With Wavy Pattern
- [`gen_rotation()`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/gen_rotation.md)
  : Generate Rotations
- [`normalize_data()`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/normalize_data.md)
  : Generate Normalized data
- [`gen_clustloc()`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/gen_clustloc.md)
  : Generate Cluster Locations
- [`gen_hole()`](https://jayanilakshika.github.io/cardinalR/reference/gen_hole.md)
  : Remove points within a spherical hole in the middle
